Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

ABOUT YOUR ROLE

As Juniper Square's R&D organization grows globally, we're adding senior technical product leaders. We're looking for an experienced product manager who does well in technically complex problem spaces that cut across teams.

In this role, you will own capabilities that benefit teams across the company, where reaching our business goals depends on cross-functional collaboration and leadership. You'll shape the vision, turn it into a roadmap, and drive adoption across the organization, while holding a high bar for quality and security. You'll own a business or product domain end to end, with direct impact on Juniper Square's growth.

You'll bring a product mindset to everything you own and operate autonomously in a fast-growing, global R&D organization. In line with our values, you'll bring first-principles thinking to your domain and put clients first in every decision. You should be comfortable taking an active part in technical discussions and be curious about technical topics. Many people come to this role after working as engineers, but that isn't required.

We'll decide your specific area during the interview process, based on your experience and business priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead a large, technically complex product area: define success, prioritize problems and set strategy with the wider company in view

 - Identify the most significant near- and long-term opportunities in your area, and build consensus on how to sequence them against engineering capacity, risk and business priorities

 - Treat shared capabilities as first-class internal products, with clear documentation and a path teams can adopt instead of building their own

 - Set adoption and reliability expectations, and track how consistently teams build on shared capabilities

 - Bring tradeoffs such as build versus buy, technical debt and sequencing into architecture discussions with engineering leadership

 - Research and benchmark industry practices and new technology, including AI, and turn the findings into strategy

 - Build and maintain feedback channels with stakeholders inside and outside R&D, and use that input to prioritize

 - Define success metrics, track KPIs, and adjust strategy as you learn and as conditions change

 - Lead by influence: inspire other teams with your technical vision, earn their trust and drive adoption

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience as a product manager or in a similar role, with at least 5 years on technical platform, data or infrastructure products

 - Demonstrated experience owning horizontal shared capabilities used by multiple teams, with a focus on driving adoption

 - Demonstrated experience working on technically complex solutions, finding clean and enduring designs for these problems that scale

 - Exceptional oral and written communication skills, and comfort explaining complex technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders within and outside the R&D organization

 - Track record of operating with high autonomy in ambiguous scope

Preferred Qualifications

 - Prior experience as an engineer

 - Concrete examples of using LLM-based agents to automate real-world workflows

COMPENSATION

ABOUT THE ROLE

North Vector Dynamics is building the next-generation unmanned systems. We’re looking for an Embedded Linux Engineer to own the software that enables these systems, from the board support packages up through the application layer. You’ll work close to the hardware, writing and debugging kernel drivers, boot code, and real-time software. You’ll report to our Flight Software Lead and work directly with our GNC, avionics, and electrical teams to bring the flight computer from bench to flight. If you want your code running on hardware that actually leaves the ground, this was written for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Design, build, and maintain the embedded Linux software running on the CM-70 interceptor’s onboard flight and mission computer, from the board support package through the application layer.

• Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers and BSP customizations (Yocto/Buildroot) for custom flight computer hardware, including sensor interfaces, communication buses, and peripheral I/O.

• Port, optimize, and maintain software running on GPU-accelerated ARM SoC compute modules, including driver bring-up and vendor SDK integration for onboard sensor processing.

• Build real-time and deterministic software components that meet the timing, reliability, and safety demands of a flight-critical system.

• Develop and maintain low-level device drivers, bootloaders (U-Boot), and system init for custom embedded hardware platforms.

• Work closely with GNC, avionics, and electrical engineers to integrate flight computer software with sensors, actuators, and communication systems (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, and similar).

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure for embedded software validation.

• Debug issues across the full stack, from kernel and driver level up through application software, using tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

• Contribute to system architecture decisions that balance performance, power, size, weight, and reliability constraints for a flight vehicle.

• Support integration, bench testing, and field testing of the interceptor’s electronics as required.

• Step into whatever the mission demands: this is a startup, and no two weeks will look the same.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

• Production experience developing embedded Linux systems, including kernel and driver development, BSP customization, and build systems such as Yocto or Buildroot.

• Solid understanding of Linux internals: process and memory management, device drivers, interrupt handling, and the boot process, including bootloaders such as U-Boot.

• Experience with embedded communication protocols and buses, such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, and Ethernet.

• Experience working with vendor-supplied Linux distributions and SDKs for ARM-based SoC compute modules, and comfort picking up a new vendor ecosystem quickly.

• Comfort working close to the hardware: reading schematics and using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers to debug issues that span software and electronics.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD for embedded targets.

• Strong experience with C++ and Python

• Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance; active clearance is a significant asset.

Preferred

• Experience developing software for flight computers, avionics, or other safety- or mission-critical embedded systems in aerospace or defence.

• Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) testing, flight software verification, or formal systems engineering processes.

• Familiarity with GPU-accelerated compute on embedded/edge platforms (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT) for sensor processing or onboard inference.

• Familiarity with Robot Operating System (ROS)

• Military background is a strong asset, we deeply value the operational context, mission focus, and technical discipline that veterans bring. Candidates with prior service in the Canadian Armed Forces or allied militaries, particularly in technical or avionics roles, are highly encouraged to apply.

• Post-secondary education in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field.

WHY NORTH VECTOR DYNAMICS

• Real ownership from day one, the systems and processes you build will be foundational to how this company operates for years to come.

• A tight-knit, high-calibre team that moves fast, holds each other to a high standard, and doesn’t waste time on bureaucracy for its own sake.

Nous construisons une plateforme AI-native destinée à nos développeurs internes, plus de 150 aujourd'hui, en nous laissant guider par une question simple : est-ce que cela raccourcit le chemin entre l'idée et la valeur créée, pour les équipes qui construisent sur notre plateforme comme pour les clients qu'elles servent en bout de chaîne ?

Le chemin le plus fluide doit aussi être le plus sûr et le plus rapide, puisque la plateforme en fait le choix par défaut. Nous construisons la voie qui maximise l'accélération par l'IA.

Ce que vous ferez :

 - Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer notre infrastructure cloud (principalement AWS) sous forme de code, avec Terraform, pour que chaque environnement reste reproductible, aussi bien par les développeurs que par les agents

 - Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions) dotés de garde-fous qui sécurisent par défaut les déploiements pilotés par des développeurs ou agents

 - Administrer et faire évoluer à grande échelle des clusters Kubernetes multirégions

 - Maintenir et faire évoluer les charts Helm et les workflows de déploiement afin qu'ils restent réutilisables

 - Renforcer l'observabilité, réinjecter ces signaux dans la remédiation assistée par IA

 - Renforcer la sécurité de l'infrastructure : analyse d'images, policy as code, segmentation réseau et configuration des pare-feux

 - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit pour répondre à leurs besoins en infrastructure

 - Permettre aux développeurs, comme aux agents, de déployer et de gérer leurs services en toute autonomie

 - Participer à la rotation d'astreinte

Votre profil :

 - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en DevOps, infrastructure cloud ou développement logiciel

 - Posture orientée IA : chacune de vos réalisations répond à une exigence de standard AI-natif

 - Solide expérience des plateformes cloud (AWS de préférence, une expérience Azure ou GCP transposable)

 - Expérience dans la mise en place et la maintenance de pipelines CI/CD, ainsi que dans la gestion des déploiements

 - Maîtrise de Kubernetes

 - Expérience avec Docker et les applications conteneurisées

 - Expérience avec les outils d'observabilité

 - Excellente capacité de collaboration et à accompagner les équipes de développement

 - Bon communicateur, capable d'expliquer clairement aux parties prenantes la complexité de la plateforme et les compromis à faire

 - Anglais courant, à l'oral comme à l'écrit

MaintainX s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle, l’origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l’âge ou le statut d’ancien combattant.

veritree & Job Overview
veritree is seeking a Carbon Coordinator to provide 12-month maternity leave coverage for our Carbon Specialist, who has led the operations and delivery of veritree’s carbon function while supporting other teams across the business. veritree’s carbon business resells high-quality, nature-based carbon credits and is scaling its portfolio and sales over the coming year. Reporting to the Head of Carbon Revenue, the Carbon Coordinator will take ownership of day-to-day carbon operations through a structured handover, including credit inventory, project diligence, reporting and pipeline management, and will ensure Sales and Customer Success are equipped to sell carbon with confidence. This is a full-time, 12-month contract starting February 2027, with roughly two months of overlap before the Carbon Specialist’s leave begins. The role has the potential to convert to a permanent position based on the scale the carbon team achieves. The role will work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations and Science.
 Key Outcomes:
1 Month Key Outcomes
 Up to speed on veritree’s carbon portfolio, contracts, pricing and 2027 targets through a structured handover with the Carbon Specialist
 Handover plan agreed with the Carbon Specialist and Head of Carbon Revenue, defining which responsibilities transfer and when, ahead of the Carbon Specialist’s leave at month 2
 Initial ownership of credit inventory and pricing table updates, with the Carbon Specialist as backup
 Working relationships established across Sales, Customer Success and Field Operations
 3 Month Key Outcomes
 Structured handover completed by month 2, ahead of the Carbon Specialist’s leave, with full ownership of project files, developer relationships, credit holds, inventory and pricing
 Full, independent ownership of day-to-day carbon operations and delivery for the duration of the leave, with inventory reconciled to registry records monthly and quotes, holds and retirements turned around within 2 business days
 Carbon RACI, designed with the Head of Carbon Revenue, in use across Sales, Customer Success and the carbon team to quote, reserve and retire credits
 Standardized developer intake applied to all new third-party carbon projects considered for the portfolio
 Monitoring technology deployment at partner sites coordinated with Field Operations
 6 Month Key Outcomes
 Portfolio review prepared for the Head of Carbon Revenue, recommending which projects to grow, hold or exit based on performance, pricing and buyer demand
 Draft sourcing and diligence framework for third-party carbon projects documented to a standard veritree can publish externally, guiding which new projects enter the portfolio
 Carbon pipeline and forecast maintained in HubSpot and reviewed monthly, tracking toward 3x pipeline coverage of the 2027 carbon revenue target
 Target list of existing customers purchasing offsets elsewhere developed with Customer Success, and Sales equipped to position carbon with current pricing, project materials and clear guidance on verified trees versus carbon credits
 Input provided to the Head of Carbon Revenue on how carbon operations should be resourced as the team scales
 Year One Focus:
 Priority: keep carbon operations accurate and on time through the handover and the Carbon Specialist’s leave
 Building: the carbon RACI, HubSpot pipeline discipline, the third-party sourcing and diligence framework, and sales enablement
 Outside this role: veritree’s own carbon project development (the Carbon Project Development Manager’s remit), and carbon sales targets and strategic partnerships (the Head of Carbon Revenue’s remit)
 What You’ll Do:
 Carbon operations & inventory
 Day to day manage carbon project files, developer relationships, credit holds and inventory following a structured handover
 Maintain an accurate credit inventory and pricing table so Sales has real-time visibility of available, reserved and retired credits
 Coordinate monitoring technology deployment at partner sites with Field Operations
 Developer intake & diligence
 Run a consistent intake process for each third-party carbon project considered for the portfolio, covering data requests, diligence files, project summaries and pricing
 Assess every new project against veritree’s selection methodology and scoring framework

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security & Remediation based in Canada .
The Senior Security Engineer will play a key role in strengthening the security of digital products, applications, and cloud infrastructure through continuous offensive testing and hands-on remediation. You will spend most of your time identifying vulnerabilities across TypeScript applications, APIs, and AWS environments, simulating realistic attack scenarios before threats can be exploited. Working within an engineering-focused product security team, you will also develop and ship code fixes, automated guardrails, and secure-by-default patterns. The role combines traditional penetration testing with emerging AI-driven security workflows, including agentic red teaming and AI-assisted vulnerability discovery. You will collaborate closely with product and platform engineers to turn security findings into lasting improvements. This is an opportunity to help shape a proactive security program in a remote, highly technical environment.

Accountabilities: Offensive security and penetration testing
 Plan and conduct red team, purple team, and application penetration tests mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, focusing on relevant threats such as account takeover, API abuse, cloud credential misuse, and data exfiltration.
 Test TypeScript web applications and APIs for common vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 issues such as broken authorization, IDOR, injection, SSRF, prototype pollution, XSS, and insecure deserialization.
 Perform continuous security testing of new features as they reach production, following agreed rules of engagement, including dedicated test accounts, restrictions on access to real member data, rate limits, and defined stop conditions.

As we continue to grow our Product Support Team with the customer experience at the heart of everything we do, we're excited to hire a Manager of Product Support to our Americas team. In this role, you'll lead an incredible group of Technical Support Specialists, collaborate closely with a high-performing team of Support Managers, and help shape how we scale exceptional customer support globally.

About this role:

In 2026, we’ve grown our North America support team from 25 to 40, and we’re not slowing down. As our fourth regional manager in the Americas, you’ll take ownership of the West Coast region, leading a team of eight specialists and shaping how that team grows.

This is more than a people-management role. You’ll build the processes, systems, and operating rhythms that keep a growing team effective, and you’ll help set the standard for how Support runs as we scale. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, enjoys building from the ground up, and can balance long-term thinking with day-to-day execution.

You will partner with other Support leaders and operations to develop and implement effective Support strategies, monitor key performance indicators, and resolve escalated customer issues. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and the broader Customer Success Teams to address customer needs, maintain support documentation, and uplevel the customer experience. You will stay current with industry trends to continuously improve support processes, foster a positive team environment, and drive professional growth and development within the support team.

Some of the projects our Support Managers have overseen recently:

 - Running the vendor evaluation and implementation of a new ticketing system

 - Overhauling the interview process of our Support Specialists, ensuring we’re capturing accurate signal at every step, confidently hiring the best talent out there

When you start, you’ll work closely with our Director of Support and VP of Customer Success – you’ll inherit a team of ~8 Product Support Specialists and will grow this team further once you’re ramped.

Role Requirements:

 - Support Leadership: You have a proven track record of leading and growing high-performing and highly technical B2B SaaS Support organizations, while driving a culture of excellence and empathy.

 - Systematic thinking: You proactively address thematic customer issues and improve Support processes, leveraging Support technologies and innovative processes to enhance the efficiency and efficacy of the Support team.

 - Customer-Centric: You have a deep understanding of B2B customer needs and have a history of ensuring outstanding support experiences.

 - Strong Technical Background: You have experience working with complex B2B software products and can understand, troubleshoot, and communicate technical concepts effectively. While you may not be an engineer, you are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, and system workflows with technical teams and translating that knowledge into actionable insights for the Support team.

 - Continuous Improvement: You are passionate about driving high standards and strive to make all processes and structures even better. Our managers have led significantly impactful initiatives such as deciding on and shifting to a new ticketing system, collaborating with recruiting to improve our interview process, and implementing SME programs as our product expands in scope.

 - Timely Issue Resolution: You are invested in overseeing the resolution of complex technical issues in alignment of our SLAs.

 - Analytical: You are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decision-making, continually improving both the team and customer experience.

 - Technical Expertise: You are well versed in Support organizations, related KPIs, and related systems (ticketing, analytics, Help Center, etc.).

You could be a great fit if:

 - You care deeply about both the customer and employee experience and derive satisfaction from enabling others to be successful.

 - You think strategically and optimize for the long term. When implementing operational changes, we’re always thinking about how it will work when a team or customer base doubles in size.

 - You strive to become a product and industry expert. You align with the goal of creating differentiation via the Support experience and being a go-to partner for your team members. You recognize the expertise the team possesses and are continuously striving to learn and maintain your own expertise in the product.

 - Your peers describe you as being detail-oriented. You take pride in operational efficiencies and consider processes from a holistic perspective.

 - You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.

 - You love to coach and enable. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help teams grow functionally and expand their technical knowledge.

 - You enjoy analyzing the Support journey and identifying opportunities for self-service and delivery improvements.

 - You thrive in representing the voice-of-the-customer as you hone internal processes, as well as advocating for manageable and efficient processes for Support Specialists.

You may not want to apply if:

 - You’re excellent at managing existing Support policies and practices, but ownership of identifying and rolling out new processes is not an area you’re comfortable with.

 - You do not want to handle customer-facing tickets, whether for escalation or ongoing learning.

 - Managing the daily Support workload according to urgency, SLAs, and staffing is not something you’re interested in.

 - You need close oversight, a clearly carved out roadmap, or step-by-step guidance to succeed. This role requires comfort with ambiguity, initiative and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to build something you're passionate about.

 - You believe there is one right way to provide support and measure success.

Our Philosophy:

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.

 - We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers – whether it be through scaled engagements (e.g. webinars), 1:1 conversations, or through written word (e.g. documentation).

 - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process.

The Interview:

 - 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

 - 45 min - Interview with Hiring Manager

 - Take-Home Assessment - one week to complete

 - Final Round:
   
   - 30 min "Customer Experience" interview with two other Customer Success leaders
   
   - 30 min "Team Insights" interview with a Support Specialist, and a Support Leader
   
   - 30 min "Support Management Approach" interview with another Support Leader
   
   - 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

 - Chat with Benji, CEO

Benefits:

 - You get to support a product that our customers are truly excited about.

 - Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 
 Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
 Your role 
 Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.
 To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.
 Who you are 
 Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
 Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
 Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
 Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
 Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
 Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
 Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
 Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

 One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
 Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
 Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
 Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
 Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

En tant que membre d’une équipe commerciale en pleine croissance, dynamique et orientée vers les solutions, le manager en souscription hypothécaire commerciale est responsable de l’analyse et de l’approbation des prêts hypothécaires commerciaux conventionnels. Il/elle doit respecter les politiques et normes de souscription en vigueur, tout en assurant la conformité aux exigences réglementaires et de contrôle. Le rôle exige également la capacité de proposer des solutions créatives et axées sur le service, dans des délais appropriés, afin de contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs du département et des cibles annuelles de financement. Le poste comprend également des responsabilités liées au crédit et à l’administration, notamment la production de rapports et la gestion du pipeline de dossiers. Le titulaire est appelé à entretenir et développer des relations avec les courtiers hypothécaires, les partenaires et autres intervenants externes, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes internes, dont le groupe Crédit et Risque.
 
 
 
As part of a growing, dynamic & solution-focused commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for underwriting conventional commercial mortgages.  The underwriter must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards, meeting compliance and control requirements, while finding creative and service-oriented solutions in a timely manner in order to achieve department goals as well as annual target volumes. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management. As well, networking with mortgage brokers, partners and other external third parties along with various staff within the Credit & Risk group & other internal departments. 

Les responsabilités !: Répartition des responsabilités 
 50 % du temps : Le titulaire analyse et souscrit des dossiers de crédit commercial, en plus d’assumer diverses tâches administratives liées au crédit, principalement pour des prêts hypothécaires commerciaux conventionnels. Il doit veiller au respect rigoureux des politiques et critères de prêt de la Banque, et soumettre ses recommandations pour approbation à la direction. Il est également responsable de s’assurer que toutes les conditions de financement sont respectées et que la documentation requise est complétée dans les délais.
 30 % du temps : Le titulaire assure une coordination étroite avec les intervenants internes (équipes de financement, gestionnaires, administrateurs, équipes de ventes commerciales) ainsi qu’externes (partenaires prêteurs, courtiers hypothécaires, clients, notaires, évaluateurs et consultants) afin de garantir un traitement efficace et rapide des dossiers, dans le respect des échéanciers de financement et des standards de service. Des visites de propriétés ou inspections sommaires peuvent être requises selon les dossiers.
 15 % du temps : Le titulaire gère activement son pipeline de dossiers, en assurant un suivi rigoureux et une gestion efficace des priorités afin de respecter les délais établis.
 5 % du temps : Le titulaire est responsable de certaines tâches administratives et de production de rapports mensuels pour le département et l’organisation, lesquels sont utilisés par la haute direction pour le suivi des activités.
 Main activities : 
 50% on a daily basis, the incumbent will analyze and underwrite commercial credit facilities together with additional credit related and administrative duties, for conventional commercial mortgage product types. Attention must be made to ensure that compliance with the company’s established lending guidelines and procedures are followed with recommendations submitted for approval to management. The incumbent is responsible to ensure all lending criteria have been satisfied on deals underwritten and outstanding documentation/conditions, if any, are being met in a timely manner. 
 30% on a daily basis, the incumbent will communicate with internal contacts (funders, managers, administrators, and commercial sales staff) as well as external contacts (lending partners, mortgage brokers, Clients, solicitors, appraisers and consultants) to ensure transactions are processed in a timely and efficient manner in order to deliver superior customer service and funding deadlines. Site inspections of properties or drive-by inspections may be required, on a deal-to-deal basis. 
 15% on a daily basis, the incumbent is responsible for pipeline review and time management of their deal flow in order to meet prescribed deadlines. 
 5% on a monthly basis, the incumbent will be responsible for various administration and reporting duties required for the department/Company, which will be relied upon by Senior Management.

 Solides compétences en souscription, avec un minimum de 2 ans d’expérience en prêts hypothécaires commerciaux et/ou en souscription résidentielle 
 Expérience démontrée en prestation d’un excellent service dans son domaine 
 Formation postsecondaire (diplôme ou baccalauréat), idéalement en administration des affaires ou en finance 
 Bonne maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office, principalement Word et Excel 
 Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes 
 Bon sens des affaires combiné à une connaissance technique des prêts garantis et des facteurs influençant le marché hypothécaire commercial 
 Excellentes aptitudes en organisation et en gestion du temps 
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément tout en maintenant un haut niveau de service à la clientèle 
 Excellentes compétences en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit 
 Disponible et motivé(e) à participer à des événements liés aux courtiers, au besoin (parfois en dehors des heures de travail) 
 Accès à un véhicule pour effectuer des visites ou inspections de propriétés 
 Knowledge/Skill Requirements: 
 Bilingualism is required

 Demonstrated service excellence within their field 
 Post-secondary education (diploma/degree) preferred , preferably in business or finance

 Effective analytical and problem solving skills 
 Strong business sense combined with sound technical knowledge of secured lending and factors affecting the commercial mortgage market 
 Excellent organizational and time management skills

 Ability and desire to attend broker related events as required (often, after hours)

 Complexité du poste et imputabilité: Complexité du poste 
 Ce poste exige une grande autonomie et la capacité de prendre des décisions de souscription judicieuses, et ce, dans des délais souvent serrés. Les dossiers de prêts hypothécaires commerciaux peuvent présenter un niveau de complexité élevé, nécessitant une approche analytique rigoureuse, de la créativité et une capacité à résoudre les problèmes de manière proactive.

Dans certains cas, l’évaluation de la viabilité des dossiers doit se faire avec une information ou une documentation limitée.
 Responsabilités et imputabilité 
 Le titulaire relève directement du gestionnaire, Crédit commercial, et collabore étroitement avec les membres de l’équipe hypothécaire commerciale.
 Il est responsable de la gestion complète des dossiers qui lui sont attribués, de l’étape initiale jusqu’au financement et au suivi post-financement. La performance globale du département dépend en grande partie de son efficacité opérationnelle, de sa rigueur et de la qualité du service offert.
 Job Complexities 
 The position requires the incumbent to be a self-starter and make sound underwriting decisions as efficiently as possible. Commercial mortgage applications can be complex in nature, requiring creative and innovative thinking and proactive problem solving. In some cases, viability is assessed with limited access to information or documentation. 
 Accountability

The accountability of the incumbent falls mainly within the parameters of their daily duties, managing their own deal flow as assigned by management (from assignment stage to post funding). The overall success of the department relies on the level of efficiency and service provided by the incumbent.
Interactions & conditions de travail : Principales interactions internes et externes

 Key Internal and External Contacts 
 The incumbent will communicate daily with management, staff within the department and company, as well as external contacts (clients, mortgage brokers, Lending Partners, etc.).

 Normal office environment with no physical demands; however there is substantial pressure, at times, placed on the incumbent due to the time sensitivity of each transaction and the level of volume faced daily. Hybrid work is expected with 1-5 days in person depending on the level and seniority of the role.

We own the shared services every product team builds on top of (identity, search, communication and our Pantry design system), the tooling that makes our engineers productive, and the release and runtime foundations that let us ship with confidence. Build it once, and every team benefits.

TEAMS YOU MIGHT JOIN

 - Product Foundation: Identity, communication, search and Pantry, including the Integrations Marketplace, Global Search and the Pantry Design System.

 - Developer Productivity: Internal tooling and IDE plugins that make every engineer faster.

 - Release + Runtime and Testing: CI/CD, SRE, FedRAMP compliance and QA. This team leans more toward infrastructure and reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Set the technical direction for the shared services and components that other teams depend on.

 - Design APIs, tools and design system components that other engineers want to use, and drive adoption across teams.

 - Improve the speed, safety and reliability of how we build, test and ship software.

 - Treat internal engineers as your customers: gather feedback, measure adoption and iterate.

THE ROLE

 - Lead the design and delivery of large, ambiguous projects end to end, from planning through production.

 - Partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Engineering leadership, and the engineers who build on your work to shape your team’s roadmap and influence the roadmaps of adjacent teams.

 - Own the long-term technical health of a platform domain: reliability, performance, and the parts of the codebase nobody notices until they break.

 - Drive architecture decisions and write the technical proposals others build against.

 - Mentor senior and staff engineers, and set the standard for code review on your team.

 - Raise the bar on tooling, testing, and delivery practices across teams, not just your own.

Our core stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL. Some teams use C# or Python. You don't need to already know every piece of it to apply. You'll land on a team of 5 to 10 people and take on-call rotation as part of the role. Within your first 6 months, you’ll own the technical direction of a platform domain or system outright.

WHERE WE WORK

We don't have a minimum in-office mandate, but we prefer our teams to be located around our office hubs. In Canada this includes: Montreal and Toronto.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of professional experience building full-stack web or mobile products, including a track record of leading technical work at a scope beyond a single team.

 - Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

 - Experience designing shared systems that held up at scale, and the judgment to know when not to build something.

 - Experience with mobile-first, responsive, iterative development.

 - A track record of writing maintainable, testable code you’re comfortable handing off to someone else.

 - Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain a technical tradeoff to a designer, a support lead, or an executive as easily as to another developer.

For this area, we also value: Experience with search technology, authentication and identity, design systems or component libraries, developer tooling or IDE extensions, CI/CD, observability, or compliance programs such as FedRAMP or SOC 2.

 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology.  The Role

 This role is designed to build mastery in discovery, account strategy, multi-threading and enterprise opportunity development.

 You will help Fenergo create and progress high-quality strategic pipeline by: 
 Strategic, signal led outreach into enterprise accounts with insight and persona relevancy & credibility  
 Exceptional Discovery which is focused on business outcomes and quantifies pain, beginning to shape the problem  and “why change” narrative. SPICED led.  
 Building Value Hypotheses that clearly articulate why a customer should change, why now, and why Fenergo.  
 Creating momentum from initial engagement through to validated opportunity creation by multi-threading across person levels and business lines. You are developing and progressing these relationships in lockstep with the FSR  
 Partnering with the FSR to ensure early customer insight converts into a stronger enterprise opportunity path  
 Improving the quality, conversion and velocity of pipeline entering the revenue system.

 Develop a deep understanding of named enterprise accounts, including their operating model, regulatory pressures, transformation priorities, technology landscape, stakeholder map and potential value drivers.

 Engage senior and varied personas  
 Create tailored messaging for different stakeholders across Compliance, Financial Crime, Operations, Client Lifecycle, Technology, Transformation, Data and Commercial leadership. 
 You will be expected to understand what matters to each persona and communicate in a way that is relevant, credible and commercially sharp. 
 Run high-quality discovery  
 Use SPICED discovery to uncover the strategic problem, business impact, decision context, critical events and stakeholder motivations behind potential opportunities. 
 You will not simply qualify interest. You will help determine whether there is a meaningful business problem worth solving. 
 Build Value Hypotheses

 You will help move engagement beyond a single contact by building relevance across the buying group. 
 Partner with Field Sales  
 Work as a close commercial partner to Field Sales Representatives. Align on account strategy, target personas, activation plans, messaging, discovery learnings and next-step commitments.

 Maintain high-quality activation plans, discovery notes and progression insights. 
 Use CRM and revenue tools consistently so that account engagement, pipeline creation and opportunity movement are visible, measurable and actionable.
 What Success Looks Like

 Strategic accounts are activated with clear rationale, not generic outreach.  
 Target personas understand why Fenergo is relevant to their business priorities.  
 Early discovery produces meaningful customer insight, not surface-level qualification.  
 Field Sales receives stronger, better-prepared opportunities.  
 Value Hypotheses are clearly documented and used to shape opportunity strategy.  
 Multi-threading improves the quality and resilience of early-stage pipeline.  
 Pipeline creation is more targeted, more evidence-based and more likely to convert.  
 You are recognised internally as a commercial operator who improves the quality of enterprise pipeline.  
 What You’ll Bring  
 We are looking for someone with strong commercial instincts, excellent communication skills and the ambition to develop into complex enterprise sales. 
 You may be a SaaS Account Executive, commercial seller, business development professional or account development specialist who has already shown that you can engage customers, understand business problems and work toward measurable revenue outcomes.

 Proven success in a commercial SaaS, technology or B2B sales environment.  
 Strong business acumen and the ability to understand complex customer problems.  
 Confidence engaging senior stakeholders with relevance and professionalism.  
 Strong discovery capability, ideally using SPICED as a framework.

 Goal orientation, resilience and high standards of personal execution.  
 Curiosity about financial services, regulatory technology, onboarding and client experience for complex clients in financial institutions   
 Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work closely with Field Sales and wider GTM teams.  
 Comfort using data, account intelligence, AI tools and market signals to improve targeting and engagement.  
 A desire to build the skills required for enterprise sales: discovery, value creation, multi-threading, account strategy and executive-level communication.  
   What Will Motivate You  
 This role is a strong fit if you want to move beyond transactional selling and build the foundations for enterprise sales.

 Learning how complex enterprise opportunities are created and progressed.

 Playing a very visible role in Fenergo’s revenue operating model.  
 Being measured on the quality and progression of pipeline, not just meetings booked.

 This is a commercial pipeline activation role. You will be expected to understand the account, shape the engagement, uncover the business problem and help create the conditions for enterprise opportunity progression

The R&D Lean Leader and Change Manager drives continuous improvement and organizational change across the Chief Technology Office (CTO), spanning R&D, test, and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. The role combines Lean methods with structured change management (Prosci / ADKAR) to improve how work gets done and to ensure new processes, tools, and ways of working are adopted and sustained.
The role also enables AI adoption for all CTO roles and mentors CTO Project Managers in foundational change management, establishing a consistent change management approach for programs.
The position works with some autonomy, guided by established policies and review of end results, and has latitude to modify procedures and practices as long as results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness, etc.). It partners closely with executive sponsors, people leaders, engineering teams, and the Project Management Office (PMO) to deliver measurable improvement and adoption outcomes. 
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Activities related to the interdisciplinary field of engineering focusing on how to design and manage complex engineering systems over their life cycles and ensuring all likely aspects of a project or system are considered and integrated into a whole.
 May eventually include direct people management responsibility including staffing and performance development and will initially work in a matrix organization. Uses in-depth technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and experience to execute policy and strategy.  Has knowledge of best practices and how these processes integrate with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market in order to be able to work within Lean/Kaizen teams to improve capabilities.
 Uses judgment and has some ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters to address manufacturing processes with technical variety and/or interdependent production cycles. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own teams to arrive at decisions.
 Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead non-NPI projects with low to medium risks and with minimal resource requirements. Explains information; developing skills to bring team members to consensus around topics within field. Conveys performance expectations and may handle sensitive issues.
 This role leads Lean continuous improvement and Prosci / ADKAR-based change management across CTO R&D, test, and NPI activities, while enabling AI adoption and building change management capability in Project Managers and leaders. Key responsibilities include:
 Lean deployment: Lead the deployment of Lean principles across R&D and engineering processes using value stream mapping, waste elimination, standard work, visual management, A3 problem solving, root cause analysis, and Kaizen events to improve quality, cycle time, and delivery predictability.
 Continuous improvement culture: Coach engineering teams and leaders in Lean practices and build sustainable improvement routines with clear metrics and ownership.
 Change leadership (Prosci / ADKAR): Lead the people side of process, tool, and organizational change using the ADKAR model (Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement), including change impact and readiness assessments, sponsor and stakeholder analysis, and resistance management.
 Change planning and execution: Develop and execute change management plans, communications, and training to drive adoption and proficiency, and measure adoption to ensure changes are reinforced and sustained.
 Sponsor and manager coaching: Coach executive sponsors and people managers to visibly lead and reinforce change and equip them to guide employees through transitions.
 Benefits and adoption KPIs: Define benefits realization measures and adoption KPIs for change initiatives and track them to demonstrate business outcomes and return on investment.
 Project Manager mentoring: Work alongside all existing Project Managers in the CTO organization to mentor and train them in foundational change management skills, including stakeholder mapping, assessing education and training plans, and ensuring a high level of adoption.
 Change management assessment: Establish a standard change management assessment for programs and projects to evaluate change impact, readiness, and adoption risk early and guide the right level of change effort, supported by reusable tools, templates, and guidance for consistent application.
 AI journey and adoption: Serve as a core partner in the organization's AI journey, helping implement AI usage and adoption for all CTO roles across R&D, test, and NPI by identifying role-specific AI use cases, defining guidance on appropriate tools and responsible use, developing training and enablement content, supporting pilots and rollouts, gathering user feedback, and tracking adoption and business impact.

 We are a venture studio. We research and validate ideas in-house, then bring in an Entrepreneur in Residence to turn the strongest of them into real companies. Each venture starts with a clear thesis, a budget and a small team already in place.

 Build

 Hand over the business cleanly and on schedule 
 Flag risks early to studio leadership before they cost time or money 
 Share lessons learned to improve how the studio builds future ventures

 MVP live with paying or active users within the first 90 days.

 Daily, practical use of AI tools to build, research and ship

 Execution  
 Speed with structure 
 End-to-end ownership of outcomes

 Comfortable making hard calls early
